topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I'm so sorry to hear about your flight delay and the important event you missed. It must feel incredibly frustrating and disappointing. I hope you can find some comfort in knowing that these things are often out of our control. If there's anything at all that can be done to make the situation a bit easier—whether it’s finding a way to reschedule or perhaps even attending the event virtually if that’s an option—I’m here to help you explore those possibilities. Take a moment for yourself, breathe deeply, and let’s figure out the next steps together.
